name: HOOK
description: Captures initial attention, disrupts scrolling feed, and creates immediate curiosity or emotional self-identification.

name: PAIN
description: Explores daily friction, suffering, spatial constraint, or emotional frustration experienced by the prospect.

name: PROMISE
description: Introduces the core possibility, transformation, or alternative available to the buyer.

name: REVEAL
description: Formal visual/narrative materialization of the person, product, development, key space, or solution that was set up previously.
core_intent: Payoff of curiosity and physical grounding of the offer

name: EXPLANATION
description: Breaks down how the opportunity, mechanism, financing, or physical layout works.
core_intent: Cognitive comprehension and elimination of confusion

name: PROOF
description: Demonstrates tangible factual evidence, specifications, real footage, or documentation validating previous claims.
core_intent: Validation of truth and risk reduction

name: DEMONSTRATION
description: Shows how the space, room, feature, or amenities are experienced in real life.

name: DESIRE
description: Evokes aspirational lifestyle, leisure, aesthetic delight, and emotional attachment to the property.

name: VALUE
description: Highlights the cost-benefit ratio, appreciation potential, luxury-to-price balance, or unique advantages.

name: AUTHORITY
description: Demonstrates market expertise, institutional security, construction track record, or professional credibility.

name: OBJECTION
description: Directly tackles, dismantles, and resolves major buyer hesitations (financial, geographical, bureaucratic).

name: OFFER
description: Articulates the specific commercial proposal, entry conditions, price point, financing program, or availability.

name: CTA
description: Directs the prospect toward a single, frictionless, immediate next action (button, link, message, scheduling).
